comment: Loved my class with Dr. El Kurd so much I took another one of her courses.

Dr. El Kurd is an expert in what she teaches & tackles questions well. She starts class by having us discuss current events and typically follows with a heavy lecture and either a pop quiz or an in-class group assignment based on a case study or article. Pop quizzes are extremely manageable if you stay on top of the heavy readings. Take this class!

funny, light-hearted, well-qualified professor, passionate about IR topics, homework daily (sizable textbook readings), daily in-class partner discussions/assignments, ocasional pop quizzes, only 2-3 papers (w/ hard deadlines), several extra credits, available during office houses & responds to email quickly, would definitely take again

Dr. El Kurd is a brilliant professor and I am so grateful to have taken her. She is so respectful and knowledgeable, and the way she runs the classroom fosters thoughtful discussions. Make sure you do the readings and pay attention to get a good grade!
Looks at your drafts before the paper. That is helpful. Lectures mostly, and some group work. I liked the topics we studied.
You have to read but most of the material is interesting. She reads your drafts and gives feedback. Grades based on rubrics. Does not take atendance but there are pop quizzes

AVOID her if you wanna get an A. She is MEAN and tries to make students that she doesn't like not getting an A. All extra credit assignments I submitted just passed the deadline got refused. I submited 8, but only got credit for 1. She gave 5% per day for late assignments even if you ask for an extension, but it takes her 4 weeks to grade it.

Attendance is not mandatory, but there are regular pop quizzes on class readings. There is a midterm, final, novel paper, and final paper. Overall she is a fair grader. Class can be pretty lecture heavy and she expects people to participate. Lots of extra credit opportunities.

I really enjoyed her class in the fall, and the content was very interesting. She gives lots of extra credit opportunities, and while the readings can be long, they are manageable and very useful for the midterm. She is also an expert on Middle Eastern politics, so if that interests you, I would highly recommend taking her!

Dr. El Kurd is an awesome professor! I really enjoyed her class, and I felt like I learned a lot. There is pretty heavy reading each week, but it is manageable, as are the assignments. Dr. El Kurd is great about reading your final draft for both of the major papers, and the exams were fairly straightforward.

Dr. El Kurd is extremely intelligent and knowledgable. Her lectures are engaging. We have two papers, a mid-term, and a final. The workload is considerably heavy. We have a lot of readings that are sometimes difficult to understand. One thing I didn't like is that she assigned our final research paper to be due the day after Thanksgiving Break.
helpful outside of class and very flexible

Will not take another Political Science class with her again. Not very understanding when you struggle with an assignment. Was annoyed with my class because we didn't do well on the midterm. Witty lectures but they can be dense and boring. If you put the work in for each assignment, you'll do well. Just don't expect lenience. Extra credit offered

Professor El Kurd is very nice. She is always having good conversation with students in class. She is very very knowledgeable about the topic. There are pop quizzes that are on the reading from the night before. She does give lots of extra credit opportunity as well, but she is a fairly tough grader.

I LOVE Dr. El Kurd, but would not take one of her classes again. The amount of reading is insane. She will sometimes give 40-50 pages of reading for one class and can be difficult. One test, pop quizzes (not often), and paper-heavy otherwise. Lot of her background is in the Middle East if that interests you.
Took her intro course. Easy in terms of requirements, and offered a ton of opportunities for extra credit. The lectures were sometimes dry but with some topics its unavoidable.

Professor El Kurd is great. Easy grader and generous with extra credit. Lectures are sometimes dull, but she lets a bit of her personality shine through which is nice. Is available outside office hours and will look over your papers before they're due. Around 14 pop quizzes, but she drops your worst 4. Overall great professor.

Not an unreasonable teacher, do the readings and the assignments are manageable. Attendance is "not mandatory" but pop quizzes/graded participation assignments almost every class. Provides a lot of time to meet outside of class. Readings are a lot, you can skim sometimes, but she expects you to remember details throughout as well. Offers extra cred
Super detailed and fascinating lectures, if you are interested in the topic of course. Extremely knowledgeable professor youll get out exactly what you put in.

Things laid out in the syllabus, just need a bit more detail for each rubric. Funny professor and lectures. She always meets with you even if you can't make it to office hours. If you try in this class then it's easy to get a good grade.

Honestly seems super uninterested in her students and acts like she doesn't want to talk to you whenever you meet with her outside of class. She acts like everything is super easy, but grades hard and is really nit-picky. Written midterm, reading pop quizzes, novel paper, essay-style final exam (3 essays), final paper with a class presentation.
